notes: GROUP INDICATE 'causes the SOURCE or VALUE clause to be ignored and spaces supplied', except on the detail group's first presentation in the report, after every page advance and after every control break (§1985:XIII.3.13.4 GR1). ReportWriter arms every detail's GroupIndicatePending at INITIATE, at each page advance and at each control break (#ArmGroupIndicate), #PresentBody reads it after the group's own page advance into GroupIndicatePresent, the emitted placement (ReportWriterEmitter#EmitFieldPlacements) leaves the indicated item out of the space-filled line otherwise, and #GenerateCore consumes the occasion at 85 only when the group was PRESENTED (DialectBehavior.GroupIndicateConsumedByIssuedGenerate is 2002+, kb/Work PB5246). Probes at 85: two detail groups across page advances and a control break each indicate exactly on their first presentation (including the detail whose own fit test advanced the page); indicated -ZZ9 from -5, BLANK WHEN ZERO, an ODO-table element WS-E (WS-C), VALUE ALL "*" and VALUE ZERO all print on those lines and are spaces otherwise while an unindicated item always prints; with neither PAGE nor CONTROL only the first detail indicates (GR2); 'GROUP' alone is accepted; the SUPPRESSed GENERATE leaves the occasion owed ([AA A 2] [     3] [AA B 5]). Refused: GROUP INDICATE in a control heading (COBOL2519), on a group entry (COBOL2247), written twice (COBOL2423), INDICATE alone (parse). The witness indicates on the first detail and after a control break and a page advance.

next.reason: 1985: "it causes the SOURCE or VALUE clause to be ignored and spaces supplied, except: a. On the first presentation"; 2023: "has the same effect as a PRESENT WHEN clause where the associated condition is true only on the first occasion that a GENERATE". 1985 supplies spaces except on the first presentation. 2023 makes the item absent (PRESENT WHEN) and counts the GENERATE issued, not the presentation, so a SUPPRESSed first detail now uses the occasion.
